items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bud would put thumbtacks on the piano seat before George would come to play.

ctx.x: Was he intimidated? I mean, or did he not…
Oh sure, because he was, yeah in fact, he was afraid of Bud. Bud would put thumbtacks on the piano seat before George would come to play.
